scope: Ordinary black-border Legends using the selected source frames. Shared mana geometry and pinned Conjurer expansion symbol; original and Oracle use the same printing geometry. Custom symbols and templates are excluded.
policy: Shared geometry fit on training only; fixed frame-normalized references. Ordinary full renderer replay with unchanged pixels outside symbol study rectangles. Scores are local two-polarity edge overlap, not whole-card accuracy.
cohort: One instrumented source render captures isolated native symbol layers. Scans retain frozen frame-only poses; cohort unchanged. These layers propose candidates only; adoption requires ordinary full-render replay.
scoreMeaning: Two-polarity one-pixel edge F1 in fixed component windows, not whole-card accuracy. OriginalBefore uses the unpatched white-rim SVG; before uses the corrected black-contour SVG at its old geometry.

runtimeVerified.note: Candidate symbolAdjustment uses a context transform; baked bounds differ in 240 antialiased channels by one byte, with identical edge scores.

remaining: Mana disc colors and ink/numeral shape are separate from this geometry fit.
Rules, artist and power/toughness remain separate calibration passes.

normalizationReview.note: Original measurements preserved. Corrected frame, color, title/type/symbol rechecks and fresh text validation are reported separately, including retained regressions.
